Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Dawid Malan and Jason Roy to open for England. Josh Hazlewood to bowl first.
...The Chase...

Right then! A total that is a really big one, England do bat deep but and should come out with nothing to die attitude as they clearly have nothing to lose from here on. Australia will eye to clean sweep. Stay tuned for the chase. THE DLS TARGET FOR ENGLAND IS 364 IN 48-OVERS.

Well, there is nothing to write about England. The scoreboard speaks for itself. When the ball was swinging, they went short and in the middle phase didn't make the most of the longer square boundaries. They were completely on the back foot and were chasing the ball for the longer part of the game. They had a much better final 10 overs as they got some wickets and got the run rate down but the damage didn't stop until the end. Olly Stone was the only one who showed some character as he ended with 4 wickets.

A comprehensive performance with the bat by Australia! Tough going for England and Jos Buttler as he had no clue what to do with the ball against some carnage. It was all possible thanks to a wonderful start by Travis Head and David Warner. The former was dropped on 4 and then made the most of the given chance. Head went full throttle and scored an amazing 152. David Warner all along played the second fiddle and went onto bring up his 19th ODI hundred. Both fell in quick succession but Marsh and the other batters played a good hand to get past 350. Australia will be absolutely delighted with this score.
TWO TO END THE FINAL OVER! AUSTRALIA END WITH A MAMMOTH 355. Fuller ball on middle, Marnus Labuschagne whips it to deep mid-wicket, little fumble and two runs are taken.
Two more! This is full and on middle. Marnus Labuschagne lofts it over mid off and will get two runs.
FOUR! 350 up for Australia! Another short ball on middle. This time Marnus Labuschagne pulls it wide of long on for a boundary.
A short ball on middle. Marnus Labuschagne looks to pull but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! A good cameo from Marsh! Stone gets his fourth! This is full and outside off. Marsh looks to go downtown but slices his shot and Liam Dawson takes an excellent shot running back from covers.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Dawson b Olly Stone

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! POWERED! This one sits nicely, short and outside off. Marsh hoicks over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On a length and on leg. Carey bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a brace. 13 off the over. Final over coming up.
Wide! Again down the leg side and the umpire stretches his arms. Jos Buttler looks unhappy.
This is full and angled away from Marsh, this is hit to deep cover for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Smacked! This is short and angling down. Carey moves back and pulls it to long on for a boundary.
Wide! Tries the slower one but bowls down the leg side. Wided.
Short in length, angling down. Carey pulls it to fine leg for a brace.
A bouncer, outside off. Marsh pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss, lower one on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Full ball, on leg. Carey flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pulled to deep square leg for a couple.

OUT! What happened there? Jos Buttler reviews it straightaway as Smith edges this one. The umpire then raises his finger. He was just waiting for Buttler to appeal. On a shorter side and on middle. Unlike Smith, who steps across and tries to paddle it over the keeper but gets a faint edge to Jos Buttler who catches but just raises his finger like an umpire. The umpire doesn't move but once Buttler appeals, the dreaded finger goes up.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Olly Stone

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and around off. Marsh inside edges his drive to square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off at 117 clicks. Marsh swings across and misses.
A yorker, widish one and Smith carves it past point for a brace. 17 runs off the over.
Full ball, outside off, eased to long off for two more.
FOUR! Well played! A fuller ball, outside off. Smith drives on the up, goes more off the outer half of the bat and to third man for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Marsh tries to heave but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls to cover for a single.
This is full and way outside off. Marsh lofts it, not off the middle and the ball falls to deep cover. Two runs.
SIX! BANG! Curran has been very off today! Short of a length and on middle. Marsh pulls it hard and over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Good over by England! This is slower and angling down. Marsh hoicks it behind square leg for one more.
Short ball, outside off. Smith toe ends his shot to mid off for a single.
Hard length delivery on middle. Marsh pulls it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, Smith smacks it to long on for one more.
Slower short ball on middle,  Marsh pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Leg bye! A length ball, following Smith on the leg side. Smith misses his flick and it goes off the pads to point for a single.
Good start from Marsh! Playing with intent! Drops it short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Fuller ball, outside off. Marsh powerfully hits it to long off for a boundary.
Full and on the pads. Marsh flicks it to mid-wicket and takes two runs to get off the mark.

OUT! TAKEN! First ball after the delay! This is full and angling on middle. Stoinis swings his bat as he tries to heave, only to get a top edge and it flies to point where Chris Jordan (sub) takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Chris Jordan b Liam Dawson

Commentary.Commentary: Okay, a confirmation as we have lost two-overs and we have a 48-side contest now. Resumption coming up...
Update - 1236 IST (0706 GMT) - A passing shower it was as the covers are coming off. Should start anytime now.
UPDATE - 1233 IST (0703 GMT) - It has gone dark, it has started to rain and the players are walking off the field. The covers are on. Another rain delay in this match.
Drops it short and outside off. Smith cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, driven to long off for a single.
On middle, this is pulled to square leg for a single.
Short in length and on middle. Smith comes down the track, had to adjust late and plays like one hammering a nail down to long on for one.
This is short and outside off, extra bounce. Smith slashes and misses.
Length ball on middle. Stoinis hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around off. Soft hands from Smith as he works it to cover.
Short of a length and around off. Stoinis pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Stoinis lofts it past the bowler and to long off for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Stoinis punches it to sweeper cover for a brace.
On off, Smith comes forward and pushes it to long off for one.
FOUR! Welcome one! Too short and outside off. Smith pounces on the room given and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
A single as this is hit to cover.
This is full and way outside off. Stoinis looks to drive but misses.
Three runs! This is full and outside off. Stoinis drives it to mid off, the fielder gets a hand and eventually runs back to save a single.
On a length, outside off and angles in. Stoinis tries to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is a good passage of play by England! Length ball, outside off. Stoinis looks to push but misses.
A length ball, outside off. Smith cuts it late to third man for a single.
Very full and on middle. Stoinis pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
A length ball on middle. Smith tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
On middle, blocked.
On a length and around off, punched to cover.
Marcus Stoinis comes up the order.

OUT! BOWLED! 150 and out for Head! All of a sudden, England have both the big man. Two in quick succession. Good bowling from Stone. And that is the end of an entertaining, magnificent innings from Head. A length ball, around leg. Head makes room and tries to go big only to miss and the ball to hit the leg stump. A much needed over from England.
Short and on middle, good pace and Head fails to cut it away.
Length ball, outside off. Smith guides it to third man for one.
Steven Smith comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Hundred and out for Warner! Finally, finally, there is something to cheer in this innings for England! A slower short ball from around the wicket and on off. Warner rocks back and pulls it to square leg, it looked like the ball will go past the fielder there but David Willey runs to his left and takes a sharp catch. He had to adjsust quickly there. End of another memorable innings from Warner. Goes back with a standing ovation.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Olly Stone

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! 150 FOR TRAVIS HEAD! He is eyeing 200 now. Milestones keep on coming. Very full and outside off. Head steps across and carves it through covers for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid off for a single.
On off, kept out.
A slower bumper and it is again pulled to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Short ball, outside off. Head pulls again to long on for one.
FOUR! Crunched! Australia scoring for fun now! On a length and on middle. Head pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball on the pads. Warner flicks it to fine leg for couple more. 19 runs off the over. Clear idea from Aussies now, have 10 wickets in hand, go hard on every ball.

FOUR! HUNDRED FOR WARNER! A master on top of the order. There is the iconic celebration of Warner as he hits the milestone. His 19th ODI hundred! A tough phase but has been superb in this series. A full toss, outside off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
Way down the leg side. Head tickles it to fine leg. Uppishly but in control.
On middle, clipped to sqaure leg for easy couple.
FOUR! Short and on off. Head gets tall, waits for the ball and upper cuts it over third man for a boundary.
SIX! This is full and on middle. Head thumps it over long on for a six.

Drinks! Australia are rocking right now. England have no clue what to do and are just chasing the ball. At this rate, Australia will look for more than 350 easily. England on the other hand will try to stop the carnage somehow. A very interesting final phase is coming up...
A bouncer on middle. Warner sits under it.
Well bowled! A yorker on middle. Head squeezes it out past point for one.
No ball! On a length and on middle, Head taps it to point. A no ball is called as Curran has overstepped! Free-hit coming up. Everything going wrong for England.
This is full and on middle, swinging on. Head looks to punch it wildly, as he gets forward but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Outside off, played to covers for one more.
A length ball, around off. Warner pulls it in the gap to deep square leg for easy two.
Wide! Pressure on Curran! This is down the leg side. Warner misses his clip.
FOUR! Loosener to start and Warner doesn't miss out. A full toss on the pads. Warner plays it fine to the fine leg fence.
Just over! Short and on middle. Head skips down and punches on the up over mid-wicket for two.
An arm ball, on middle, Warner works it to square leg for one.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for one.
Flatter ball, outside off, Head slaps it to cover.
SIX! A welcome boundary for the Aussies! This is full and on leg. Head makes room and slog-sweeps it over the cow corner region for a biggie.
Short and on middle. Warner pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Just 5 off the over! Australia ever so slightly on the back foot! A short ball on middle. Head waits on the back foot to ramp it over but misses.
Tight from Curran! Around off, Warner drops it to point for one.
Curran goes too full and on off. Head jams it out to deep point for one.
A full toss, outside off. Warner pushes it through covers for a single.
On a length and on middle. Head pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Serves a full ball on the pads, whacked to deep square leg for one.
Another good over from England! No boundaries!This is full and on middle, too full and Head smacks it to long on. Good fielding from Chris Woakes as he dives to his right. Two runs.
Slants it across, outside off. Warner slaps it to deep cover for one.
On middle, Head clears his front leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
This is full and on off. Warner reches to the pitch of the ball as he taps it to covers. A single.
Slower ball on the pads, spins in. Warner fends it away.
This is full and on middle. Head whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
No boundaries in last 3 overs. Just what England needed! Full and on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
On middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Goes full but way down the leg side. England are not able to create any pressure.
A slower bouncer on middle. Head pulls it to square leg for one.
A length ball on middle. Warner eases it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short ball on middle. Head gets tall and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on middle. Warner works it to square leg for one. The stand now moves to 200 between these two.
Flatter and on middle. Head punches it hard but back to the bowler.
Slower, full and on middle, Warner bunts it to mid-wicket for one.
On middle. Warner pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Sharp second run. Good running.
On the pads, clipped past square leg for one.
Drops it short and outside off, it's pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed to cover.
This is full and on middle. Warner on drives it to mid on and keeps the strike.
Leg bye. A full ball on the pads. Head misses his flick again and it rolls off the pads to square leg.
Wide! This is going down the leg side. Head misses his flick.
A bouncer, outside off. Head knocks it through point for a couple.
Short in length and on middle, Head tries to ramp it over but fails.
Short ball, slower and on off. Head hops and drops it to cover.
Angles on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This time hits it cleanly. This is full, way outside off. Head waits before swinging his bat. He connects well and deposits it over mid on for four.
A length ball, around off, this one lands and jags back sharply. Head somehow plays it to short third man.
On middle, it is hit to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for one.

In the air but safe! This is full and way outside off. Head swings across, hits off the toe end of the bat. The ball flies over mid on where Liam Dawson runs back but is not in his range. One. Chris Woakes is not happy as Liam Dawson misjudged it.
A slower length ball, outside off, it nips away. Head looks to push but misses.

FOUR! 12 off the over! England are trying the short ball but the line is too wayward from them. This is angled on leg. Warner backs away and places it over the keeper for a boundary. This is just too easy for both of them right now.
On a length and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Length ball on the pads, Warner pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good bowl now! A slower bouncer on middle. Warner evades it well.
SIX! Warner now wants to get into the act! Pitched up on middle, slanting in. Warner launches it high over long on for a biggie. Nothing ball really.
Length ball on off. Head keeps it out.

FOUR! CENTURY FOR HEAD! What a knock this is from the opener! His third ODI hundred! The man is loving his time on top of the order! Gluing his place! Short ball, way outside off. Head opens the face of the bat and dabs it to backward point for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Warner punches it to the right of mid off for a single.
Short in length and on middle. Warner pulls it to mid-wicket.
Moves to 96. Slower short ball on middle, this is pulled behind square leg for one.
On the pads, Warner pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Seond off the over and this time Head does what he wanted to do earlier! Short and outside off. Head waits and ramps it behind the keeper to the third man fence.
This is short and outside off, Head tries to play the ramp shot but misses.
This is on a length and on middle. Warner taps it to point for a single.
Short in length and outside off. Head dabs it to third man for one.
FOUR! Head moves into the 90s! This is full and outside off. Head smacks it high over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On a length and around off, Warner pushes it towards cover for one.
A dot to end! On a length and around off, defended.
FOUR! 150 up for the Aussies! On the pads, Head clips it fine and this one races away to the fence. That is a poor ball and it is put away nicely.
On a length and around off, Warner pushes it through covers for one.
On the shorter side and outside off, Warner looks to cut but chops it towards the keeper.
Bangs it short and on the body, Head pulls it through square leg for one.
Leading edge but safe! That one took off! Length and on off, Warner looks to flick it on the leg side, it goes off the leading edge down to third man for one.
Three dots in a row to end but still a good over for the Aussies! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, Head guides it to point.
Bangs it short and outside off, Head looks to cut but misses.
Make that two more! Shorter and outside off, this is cut over point for a couple.
FOUR! That has been belted down the ground! Yet another one right in the slot. Full and on off, Head thumps it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Stone is not having a good day so far.
WIDE! Bangs it short but down the leg side and too high too. Wided.
Angled into the middle pole, Warner works it through square leg and takes one.
A single to end! On the pads, Warner works it through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
Flatter and on off, Warner pushes it down to long off for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shortish and on off, Head pushes it to covers.
On middle, Head works it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Driven hard but to mid on! Fuller and on middle, this is hit to mid on.
Moeen Ali can't be bowling as he is replacing Salt who was playing as a specialist batter.
That should have been two! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point and wide of third man but the two settle for one.
Yet another short one and on the body, Warner looks to pull again but misses to get hit on the pads.
Off the pad! Down the leg side. Warner looks to pull but it goes off the pad and it is taken by the keeper.
Fuller and on middle, Warner plays it to mid on.
Another single to end as this is pulled through square leg again.
On the pads, Head works it through square leg and takes one.
On the pads, this is swept through square leg for one more.
Another run! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Fifty for Warner! His second in the series. He has played second fiddle to Head but it has been a really good knock! He gets there by working this through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Warner takes him on and clears the fence! That is right in the slog. Tossed up on middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! That is a nothing dleivery. With no mid-wicket in place, it is a poor ball! Shorter and on middle, Head pulls it hard through mid-wicket and this one races away to the fence.
Just the one! Shorter and on off, Warner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Tip and run! First one after the delay! On a length and around off, this is guided to point for one.
Starts off with a length delivery on off, defended.

Time for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle and so do the Aussie batters, Head and Warner who will resume their innings. Also, an update about Philip Salt, he has been replaced and Moeen Ali is his concussion substitute.

The cover on the pitch is now coming off too and the umpires are in the middle having a look. We might not be far away from resumption. We have a time, play will be resuming in just around 10 minutes, 1050 IST (0520 GMT) to be precise.

Well, the covers seem to be coming off as the rain has stopped! Let us hope we resume play quickly. Only the pitch is covered at the moment, it is not raining currently but there are some dark clouds over the ground and that maybe the worry for the umpires at the moment.

Out of nowhere it has started to rain really hard! It was cloudy throughout but now it is pouring, the players are making their way off and the covers are coming on. The radar is quite decent though throughout the day and we do not expect this rain to last for long. As we write that, it is clearing up.
Back of a length and on off, Head pushes it to mid off.
On off, Warner pushes it through covers for one more.
SIX! BANG! That goes all the way! Head steps out, he gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over the long on fence for a big one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Three more! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for three.
On off, this is guided towards point for one.
Outside off, Warner guides it to point.
100 up for the Aussies. For the second time the two have added 100 in this series. On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On off, Warner pushes it to covers. A maiden by Curran. A good one, England need more of these.
Goes shorter and around off, this one shapes away a little. Warner looks to pull but in the end, just puts bat on ball.
Nearly chops it on! Shorter and outside off, Warner looks to cut but gets an inside edge which goes just past the off pole.
Good length and on off, Warner pushes it to covers.
Angled into the pads, Warner looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. That one was quick.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
Warner steps out, he does not quite get to the pitch of it but still hits it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Pushes this through and on off, Head pushes it back to the bowler.
A low full toss, this is flicked but to mid-wicket.
Two more! On middle, Head sweeps it hard towards deep square leg. Two taken.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Head cuts but to point.

DRINKS! Australia ion control here! Their openers have gone past the tough period and now look all set. The platform is already laid by them for a big score it is now about capitalizing on it. England on the other hand, need wickets and quickly, this is a long batting line-up and if they do not manage to do so, they can well be chasing a huge total. Can the break work for them?
A dot to end! On off, Warner guides it to point.
A quick run! On middle, Head nudges it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
BEAUTY! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Head looks to defend but is beaten.

FOUR! Hammered back down the ground! Fifty for Head and he brings it up in style! This is full and on middle, Head thumps it down the ground and this one races away to the fence. He is having a really good series and is enjoying his time as an opener. Can he make it into a big one?
WIDE! Short again and on the body, Head ducks under it.
Bangs it short on middle, Head rides on top of the bounce and plays it on the off side.
On the shorter side and outside off, this is slapped past cover for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. A tidy start then from Dawson.
That has gone just over the off pole! Shorter and outside off, this lands and turns back in. Head looks to cut but misses. It goes just over the off pole.
Outside off, Warner pushes it through covers for one.
On the shorter side, this is pulled wide of the fielder at long on for two.
Flatter and on off, Warner pushes it to covers.

That was close! Shorter and outside off, Warner pushes it towards cover and wants a run. He is off. The fielder at cover dives to his right and stops it. Seeing that effort Warner is sent back. The fielder fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off but the batter is in with a dive.
Extra bounce! On the shorter side and outside off, Head looks to cut but misses.
Nicely played! Outside off, shorter, Head guides it past point and takes two more.
Another short one and on middle, Warner pulls it nicely towards deep square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Head pulls it through square leg for one.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Head hits it hard but to mid on.
Fuller and on middle, Head pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Crunched away! Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit and Warner cashes in, he cuts it past point and this one races away to the fence.
Back of a length and outside off, Head slaps it through covers for one.
Good length and on middle, Head guides it towards point.
Back of a length and on middle, Head defends.
On the shorter side, Head slaps it through covers for two.
Slightly shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Angled into the pads, Warner works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Good length and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on.
That one zips through! Shorter and on the body, Head looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pad. It rolls towards short fine leg for one.
On the fuller side again around off, Warner pushes it towards cover. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
Looks to go really full again but serves another full toss. This is hit to the right of the mid off fielder for one.
Starts off with a full one on middle, Head jams it out.
Slightly shorter and on the body, Warner pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Fuller and outside off, Head hits it through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Warner waits and then plays it down to third man for one.
Another short one just outside off, Warner initially looks to pull but then leaves it.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Warner pulls but to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Head works it through square leg and takes one.
A dot to end a brilliant Powerplay 1 for the Aussies! Shorter and outside off, this is chopped towards cover.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Warner looks to cut but chops it towards cover.
Angled into the pads, Head works it through square leg for one.
Off the outside edge again! On middle, this one shapes away too. Warner looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Angled into the pads, Head works it through square leg for one.
Uppish but safe! Fuller and on off, Head looks to loft it down the ground but it goes off the outer half over cover for two.
A beauty to end but the damage was done earlier on. 12 from Stone's first! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Warner is beaten as he tries to poke at it.

FOUR! That is yet another boundary! A valiant effort from Salt but in vain! This is full and outside off, it is hit through covers. Salt runs after it and then dives but fails to stop it. He has hurt himself in the process and looks in trouble. The physio has run across to have a look.
That one takes off after landing! Slightly shorter and outside off, Warner looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Warner looks to cut but chops it towards cover.
FOUR! Hammered! This is shorter and on middle, it sits up to be hit. Warner rocks back and hammers it through mid-wicket. No chance for the fielder again.
FOUR! A loosener to begin with and it is put away! Short and wide outside off, Warner cracks it past cover and this one races away to the fence. 50 up for the Aussies in no time.
On the bounce to the fielder! Fuller and on middle, Head looks to go hard again but this goes off the inner half to mid on.
Good amount of movement again! Around off, this one moves away. Left alone by Head.
Goes short now, Head looks to nudge it past the short fine leg fielder but can't beat him.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Head pushes it to mid on.
SIX! BANG! Over the fence! This is a top shot! Fuller and on middle, Head lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie. First of the game and Head is in full flow now.
Really full and on off, Head jams it out towards cover.
A leg bye to end another good over for the Aussies! On the pads, Head looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. Leg bye taken.
FOUR! This is crunched! Width on offer and Head pounces on it! Outside off, on a length, Head leans into it and creams it through covers for a boundary. Second in the over.
Nice carry! Back of a length and just outside off. Head shoulders arms to this one.
A lot of movement again! Shorter and outside off, this lands and moves away. Head looks to slash at it but misses. Frustrating times for the visitors.
Back of a length and on off, Head pushes it to mid off.

TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Yet again luck on the side of the Aussies! Short and on middle, Head looks to pull, this flies off the top edge and goes over the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
This one whizzes past the outside edge! Fuller and outside off, shapes away. Warner goes after it away from the body but is beaten.

That one stayed a touch low! Half an appeal from the players behind the stump but nothing from the bowler! Length and on middle, this one stays a touch low. Head jumps as he tries to flick, he misses and gets hit near the knee roll. An appeal but turned down. A leg bye taken as the ball rolls on the leg side.
FOUR! Hit hard down the ground! This is fuller, it is a half volley on off, Head thumps it past mid off and into the fence.
Tidy from Willey again! On middle, Head works it to mid-wicket.
Head swings really hard but only connects with thin air. This is full and outside off, Head looks to hit it hard through the off side but misses.
Some nice swing, it lands and then moves away from around off, left alone by Head.
Warner now probably misses out! This is short and outside off, Warner looks to cut but chops it towards point.
Head may feel he missed out there! This is full and on the pads, it is flicked but straight towards fine leg for one.
Three more! Slightly shorter in length and on off, Warner stands tall and pushes it through covers. Three taken.
Slightly shorter this time and on middle, Warner pulls but the man at mid on stops it well by diving to his right.
Closer to the off pole this time, Warner pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Not a lot of width on that one and Warner puts it away! Short and outside off, Warner cuts it past point for a bondary. Good start to the over and that is two boundaries in a row for the Aussies.
FOUR! The last ball spoils the over somewhat! Not the delivery Willey would have wanted to bowl. On the pads, Head clips it fine on the leg side and this one races away to the fine leg fence.
Five dots in a row now! Back of a length and on off, Head guides it to point.
Well bowled again! Length and on off, hint of movement away. Head keeps it out.
Another one on a length and around off, Head defends.
That is a beauty! Not a lot you can do with that one. Length and this starts around middle and off. Shapes away. Head is beaten all ends up as he tries to defend.
Good length and on off, Head looks to drive, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Just short and just wide! All the luck favoring the hosts so far! On a length, Warner looks to hit it on the up but does so uppishly and more off the splice. It lobs to the right of mid off. The fielder dives but it lands just short of the fielder who makes decent half-stop. Two still taken. A testing over then from Woakes.
Back of a length and on off, Warner plays it to covers.
Slightly fuller and gets it to tail back in a little. Warner defends it to mid on.
Good length and just outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Head works it through square leg and gets to the other end.

A LOUD APPEAL AND THE FINGER IS RAISED! Head is given out LBW but he reviews. It could be high and the pitching could also be an issue. Could turn out to be a good review. No bat but it is pitching outside leg. NOT OUT! Head survives to fight another day. Good review in the end. This lands around leg and goes on with the angle. Head goes back and looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. A loud appeal and the finger is raised. Celebrations are cut short.
A dot to end! The over could have had a wicket in it but instead goes for 7! The last ball is on a length and around off, defended.
Well left! Length and outside off, nice shape away, Warner watches it go to the keeper.
A quick run! On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Shot but well fielded! Fuller and on middle, Head pushes it back to the bowler firmly. Willey does well to get down and stop it.
WIDE! A lot of siwng now, this though is well outside off. Left alone. Wided.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! That was a sharp chance but a chance. Not taken by Liam Dawson! This is full and well wide outside off. Head throws his bat at it, it flies off the outside edge towards second slip. Dawson leaps and looks to take it above his head but the ball bursts through and goes down to the third man fence for the first boundary of the game.
WIDE! This one is down the leg side now. Head looks to flick but misses. Wided.

Goes really full, not a lot of movement, it is on off and Head jams it out towards cover. Not a lot of swing for the bowlers so far. We saw in the T20 World Cup, there was a lot of movement for the bowlers on this wicket but not here so far.
Three to end a good first over for the Aussies! On the pads, this is clipped past square leg for three.
On middle, defended.
Good stop again! Slightly shorter and outside off, Warner guides it towards point. The fielder dives to his left and stops it. A single only.
Back of a length and on off, kept out.

EDGED BUT WIDE! Excellent fielding by Curran! Length and around off, angling away. Head throws his bat at it, it flies off the outside edge past second slip and it races towards the third man fence. Curran moves to his right, dives and saves three for his side. Australia and Head are underway.
On the money to begin with! Length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.

We are all set for the action to begin! The England players make their way to the between and so do the Aussie openers, Travis Head and David Warner. Chris Woakes has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
AUSTRALIA (PLAYING XI) - David Warner, Travis Head, Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Alex Carey (WK), Mitchell Marsh, Marcus Stoinis, Sean Abbott, Pat Cummins (C), Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, James Vince, Sam Billings, Jos Buttler (WK/C), Chris Woakes, Sam Curran, Liam Dawson, David Willey, Olly Stone.
TOSS - England have won the toss and OPTED TO FIELD!

England have been outclassed in all areas and have nothing but to play for pride. England rested some key players for the first game, then tried to square up in the second ODI but both results went against them. Expect both teams now to try their bench and make some changes. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

Hello and welcome to the final ODI between Australia and England. The series has been already decided as the hosts have taken an unassailable lead and have a chance to whitewash now. It is a superb reply from them after the World Cup and will look to end on a high.
...Match Day...

A couple of comprehensive wins and Australia are on the cusp of registering a clean sweep over the reigning world champions. The series may have looked inconsequential, as it's not part of the World Cup Super League, but it has started preparations for the ODI World Cup, which is less than 12 months away, and the Australian team will be delighted with the way they have performed so far. The hosts have done well in all departments and will be looking to maintain the same momentum and intensity. Steven Smith has been on fire after spending time on the bench during the recently concluded ICC T20 World Cup. He has been batting like a man possessed, and the others have also stepped up around him. Mitchell Starc showed in the last match that the fire is still burning, while Adam Zampa's progress has been exceptional in the last few years. The leggie plays a big role in the middle phase of the game and altogether, Australia are looking well-oiled in all the facets of the game. The same cannot be said for England, who have a depleted squad with a few regular faces missing. Also, after the recent high of winning the mega event, albeit in a different format, it becomes a bit tough to stay motivated. That said, the English team is a professional outfit and will be trying everything possible to avoid a clean sweep. They suffered top-order collapses in the first two games - a major reason behind their struggle in the series and will have to correct it. In addition, the inability of the English bowlers to pick wickets in the middle overs has also hurt them. It's expected that both the regular captains will return, and we could see more changes in personnel with the series already locked in Australia's favour. The iconic MCG will be hosting this affair, and the pitch here offer some assistance to the pacers with the new ball. Having said that, the spinners also enjoy bowling here, with the boundaries being on the larger side, and that will bring the likes of Adam Zampa and Adil Rashid into the picture. Let's hope for a close game.
